subject: Budget range validation - PayBridge monthly spend bands
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Li <sophie.li@paybridge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: Budget range validation / token volumes

Hi Sophie 
— thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and a couple of follow ups so we can validate pricing/PO thresholds on our side: 

Recap:
- PayBridge primary use case: real-time payment routing + smart routing assistant for merchant support.
- Expected steady-state usage: ~1.0-1.5M tokens/month initially; product-driven spikes up to ~5-8M tokens/month during peak cycles.
- Model profile: single-stream generation + embeddings for search (mix approx. 70/30 generation/embedding).

What we need from you to qualify pricing and procurement next steps:
1) Confirm the rough monthly budget band you have in mind for a 6-12 month pilot (e.g., <$5k/mo, $5k-20k/mo, $20k-50k/mo, >$50k/mo).
2) Procurement/finance thresholds: at what contract value do you require PO, legal review, InfoSec questionnaire, or s2s controls? (e.g., any >$25k/yr requires legal).
3) Target unit economics: do you have a target $/1M tokens or an acceptable per-month spend for the pilot?

Attached is a simple 1M-token breakdown we use internally to map unit economics to discount tiers — happy to tailor it once you confirm the band.

If it helps, we can propose a 30-60 day pilot with committed credit and clear KPIs (we usually do a $20k committed pilot for accounts in your tier, with volume discounts if you hit >10M tokens/mo).

Next step: if you can share the two data points above (budget band + procurement thresholds), I'll have Marissa spin up a pilot SOW and a sample pricing schedule.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Sr. Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments: PayBridge-RDI-1M-token-breakdown.xlsx (stated values only)

From: Sophie Li <sophie.li@paybridge.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Daniel Kim <daniel.kim@paybridge.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Mar 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Budget range validation / token volumes

Hi Neha — thanks for the clear recap. A few answers below: 

1) Budget band for pilot: we expect to start in the $5k-20k/month range for the first 2-3 months. If performance/costs look good, we could scale to $30-60k/mo within 6 months.

2) Procurement thresholds: anything >$50k requires Legal + InfoSec review. Finance prefers a PO and Net30 for recurring vendor spend; credit-card payments are acceptable for pilots <$10k. Our procurement lead is Daniel (cc'd).

3) Target unit economics: for us a target of ~$50-75 per 1M tokens would be attractive for the baseline model mix (generation-heavy). If dedicated or higher-SLA options are >2x that, we'd need to see demonstrable latency/cost benefits to justify.

Procurement timeline: ~2-4 weeks for a pilot simple SOW + PO if no major InfoSec items. For anything requiring legal/InfoSec review it becomes 4-8 weeks.

Let me know if you want an internal PO number and I'll loop Daniel in to start the PO path.

Best,
Sophie
Senior PM, Product Ops
PayBridge

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Li <sophie.li@paybridge.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Mar 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Budget range validation / token volumes

Hi Sophie — great context, thanks. A couple quick notes from Redwood on pricing and an ask so we can get a pilot SOW out the door: 

- Baseline hosted pricing (example): $60 per 1M tokens for the standard generation model; embeddings priced separately (we can provide blended rates based on your 70/30 mix).
- Volume discounts: 10% at >5M tokens/mo, 20% at >15M tokens/mo, committed dedicated pricing available for >50M tokens/mo or reserved capacity.
- Pilot option: we typically do a 30-60 day pilot with a $15-25k committed credit (you can pay by CC for <$10k or provide a PO for larger pilots).

Sophie — can you confirm:
- If $60/1M (baseline) with a 10% discount at your expected 5-8M spikes is within the acceptable range for you?
- If you're comfortable starting via CC for initial pilot spend <$10k while procurement lines up a PO for the rest?

If yes, I'll attach a short pilot SOW (no legal heavy lifting) and a DocuSign link for signatures. We can also include explicit SLA and data-retention terms for InfoSec if needed.

-Marissa
Director, Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachment: RDI-pilot-sow-template.pdf (stub)

From: Sophie Li <sophie.li@paybridge.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Daniel Kim <daniel.kim@paybridge.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Mar 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Budget range validation / token volumes

Thanks Marissa / Neha — that all sounds reasonable. A few final confirmations so we can move forward: 

- $60/1M baseline with an expected 10% discount during spikes is within the range we can evaluate; our internal target was $50-75 so this fits.
- We'll start with a 45-day pilot at $20k committed credit. Finance will charge the first $8k on a company card to start immediately and issue a PO for the remainder.
- Procurement contact: Daniel Kim <daniel.kim@paybridge.com> — he will start the PO process and loop in legal if needed.
- Timeline: please send the pilot SOW + DocuSign link and I'll route to Daniel; target to have PO in 7-14 business days.

Next steps for Redwood: send SOW + DocuSign and a simple pricing schedule + sample monthly invoice so Finance can map to our cost center.

We're excited to partner — Sophie

--
Sophie Li
Senior PM, Product Ops | PayBridge
Cell: +1 (415) 555-0198

Procurement: Daniel Kim <daniel.kim@paybridge.com>
